concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-payment-methods-customer-area]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms Customer Area guide for merchant/store payment-method requests, account-holder receivePayments gating, country edits and 90-day inactive deletion.
warnings: A submitted/added/default-enabled method is not necessarily usable; account-holder receivePayments requires valid verification, enabled=true and allowed=true, and legal-entity/account-holder changes can disable methods pending reverification.
Post-submission failure without webhook alert carries a conditional 24-hour retry wait; inactive unused methods and closed-store methods have 90-day deletion conditions.
Customer Area detail steps show country/region edits, while nondefault currency changes are directed to Support; method/currency/integration support still governs eligibility.
